{{Quote|And stop kshhhing in my ear. You do that every morning, too. Just once I wish I could hear the bark of a dog, or the meow of a cat, instead of the kshhhhh of a mooka.|[[Ken]]|<ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
The '''mooka''' was a small creature with avian physical attributes.

Mookas were covered in fur and feathers, with bird-like beaks and tails, four ears and clawed feet. They were easily domesticated, and often kept as pets. [[Halagad Ventor]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] kept pet mookas as a boy. The [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|Jedi Prince]] [[Ken]] once owned a pet mooka which he named [[Zeebo]].
